verdict.rationale: The Rive homepage claims users can 'let an agent generate them with the CLI' (rive-docs-26), indicating an official CLI exists for AI-agent workflows, but no other evidence pack item documents CLI installation, commands, or usage — most AI-agent tooling evidence instead centers on the MCP server and in-editor AI agent, not a standalone CLI. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI docs/reference, install instructions, command examples, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the CLI working.
